text: oh also, can u give me a simple way to flip the face when creating one. seems to be im always picking the wrong edge first and then it makes it upside down just annoying
resolution: Added a 'flip' face op to the Studio editor: Create Face winds the new face from edge-pick order, so picking the wrong edge first makes it inside-out/upside-down. New pure flipFace() reverses a face's loop and its per-corner UV in lockstep so the normal flips with the mapping intact; a face-mode 'flip' button reverses every selected face (works on any face, not just freshly-created ones). Verified by a headless test (negated normal, uv reversed in lockstep) in the 56/56 editMesh suite; full cart bundles clean. Committed cc4b0ca15.
